reason: I already have my supplement and I reorder it when it runs out, so I am not looking for a new one. Two capsules a day is still capsules, and the sachet does not change that for me.
objection: I already take Toplux or Goli and it works for my routine. I have no reason to switch to a brand I have never heard of, for $30 a month.
would_change_my_mind: If my current one ran out and I saw a creator I trust using this one for sleep, with a lower first-box price, I might try one box.
